title: LinkStatusCheck
description: One append-only log entry from an automated reachability check of a dataset's link. Entries are never overwritten, so the history of a link's availability over time is preserved directly in git.

reachable.description: Raw HTTP signal: true if the response status was < 400. A 403/429 from bot-blocking publishers counts as unreachable here even though the link itself is fine for a human in a browser -- see likely_bot_blocked.

likely_bot_blocked.description: True when http_status is 403 or 429, the classic signature of a publisher's anti-bot/anti-scraper defense rather than a dead link. Added after the first real check run showed ~90% of 'unreachable' results were ACS/Wiley/ScienceDirect/etc. blocking the checker's User-Agent, not link rot. Absent (not false) on entries logged before this field existed -- do not treat a missing value as 'confirmed not blocked'.
